Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1275
Claimant:
Alexander Cooper
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
30 Jul 2024
Calim received from the policyholder reporting a sideswipe while changing lanes on a multi-lane road. The insured
vehicle's right rear quarter panel and mirror housing show damage consistent with the reported contact.
13 Aug 2024
Policyholder's household member was driving at the time of loss and is covered as a household member under the
policy. Coverage was in force on the date of loss, and nothing suggests the damage predates the policy start.
21 Aug 2024
Police report obtained, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the scene and records the lane change as the
reported cause. Responding officer's notes mtach the parties' initial statements.
24 Aug 2024
Photographs submitted by the insured show the vehicle damage in detail and confirm several scene features
described in the first statement. No independent witnesses have come forward to date.
18 Sep 2024
Claimant's counsel has written to advise that the claimant is represented and requests that all further contact go
through the firm. Direct contact with the claimant has been stopped accordingly.
22 Oct 2024
Claimant reports neck and upper back pain with whiplash-type symptoms following the impact. It is not yet clear
whether the reported injury came from this crash, and medical records are being requested.
22 Nov 2024
Inspection of the insured vehicle completed. Damage pattern matches the described impact, and no earlier damage
to the vehicle is known from prior claims or repair records.
29 Nov 2024
Claimant's medical file received. No earlier injury to the same body area is known from the records provided, and the
treating provider notes a usual course of care following the reported event.
15 Dec 2024
Claimant's counsel forwarded a revised statement adding minor dteails about the lane change and the vehicle's
speed. The core account is unchanged from the initial report.
27 Dec 2024
Treatment records show physiotherapy that followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved. Treating
provider notes reduced symptom reports over the most recent visits.
20 Jan 2025
Reviewed the file with the claims supervisor. The vehicle damage supports the reported mechanism, and the injury
question remains open pending the medical review requested from the independent examiner.
3 Feb 2025
File status updated to awaiting the independent medical review and the counsel's damages package. Reserve held at
current level until the injury causation question is resolved.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
